posts.name: bolnerap
posts.cooked:
Absolute Zero, Freedom Six Unity, Dark Watch Mr. Fixer, and Santa Guise vs. Gloomweaver (on Ultimate) in the Realm of Discord. Randomized start. 

I had a relatively easy time with this one, final HP 10/19/23/20, and that's mostly because AZ did one of his patented 15-self-damage Thermal Shockwaves.

Gloomy opened with the Grimoire and got the Pouch of Bones out in round 3, but otherwise, he whiffed on a couple of Vast Followings and played out a couple pins and Profane Zealots before he went down.

AZ was fully set up with Apertures, both modules, Thermal Shockwave, and both Impales in short order thanks to presents from Guise and an early Time Flies. He did the lion's share of the damage.

Unity had very poor draws and was paralyzed by the Grimoire, though an early Stealth Bot did serve us well and saved us from 1 discard per round. By the time Fixer pulled out Salvage Yard to help Unity get her hand together, Gloomy was already mostly dead.

Fixer opened Jack Handle / Grease Monkey Fist and ended up with three Bloody Knuckles by the end of round 3, so he played crowd control while AZ focused on Gloomy.

Guise passed out presents quickly in the first two rounds thanks to Hasty Augmentation and I Can Do That Too! AZ's presents were the only really useful stuff, though. He got to copy Glacial Structure and draw a bunch of extra cards, but it didn't amount to much.

posts.name: Melkhor
posts.cooked:
Poor Gloomy, even on Ultimate he just can't seem to get it together to pose an actual threat. Mint with Unity on 17 as the lowest here. I'll admit, I was a little disheartened when Gloomweaver opened with the Pouch of Bones, but he then proceeded to waste all of his Vast Followings, and Guise gimmicked the drum into his trash after they were all gone.

Unity rapidly built up a vast bot army and chewed Gloomy down to size with platform bots and shockwaves, and Absolute Zero did the rest. Special mention should go to Mr. Fixer though, for shutting down Gloomweaver (well, his pins, really) for two rounds by deflecting damage from Ethereal Bonds back to him, fun stuff!

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
That was fun. :D

The secret to Ultimate GW is ignore the relics. You can't kill them, so don't bother! Focus (non-melee and projectile) damage on Gloomweaver and you'll take him down in no time.

Also, it turns out having indestructible targets on the field means Mr. Fixer never runs out of things to bounce Dual Crowbars off of. :3 Just get that Grease Monkey Fist first!

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
I did not turn my frown into eldritch power to spite a world that has wronged me - I turned it upsidedown instead!

 

Mint.  The book came out almost immediately, but AZ started out with Sub-Zero Atmosphere, Mr. Fixer started with Jack Handle and quickly drew Dual Crowbars and Meditation, and Unity started with Swift Bot and Stealth Bot.  After that it was easy - all three Vast Followings got dumped early, and I never saw the other two relics.  Subzero Atmosphere made the cultists easy to deal with, and Stealth Bot turned the Negative Energy Field into a positive effect.  Never lost a bot, and the heroes probably did more damage to themselves then the Cult did to them.

posts.name: Blackfang108
posts.cooked:
Mint. I got the Drum on turn 1.  That was fun, being low on cards.  Sacced some presents to the drum, but it didn't slow me down.

That said, PoB and SotG didn't come out until after there were no Zombies, and he mostly played pins (OtD hit like a train, but only got a couple of hits in in the first place)

AZ never saw his Apetures,but he had every copy of both modules in hand and most Modular Realignments by turn 3.  Add an early Impale, a present of Cold Snap and Thermal Shockwave (Never actually used.  Imbued Fraility was out, and there was no way I was intentionally doing 25 damage to myself at 15 hp)

Took Gloomy down after relic 3 came out, before he flipped.

Long and sloggy, due to a long staying Time Crawls, but that also helped keep Stealth Bot.

posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
Mint. Things looked bad at first at Gloomy pulled a Cursed Acolyte on turn one and I drew very little damage output.  He walloped on me for a few turns, bringing the heroes HP down to the low teens. 

However, once Fixer drew crowbars and monkey fist and the team started opening Santa Guise's presents things turned around quickly.  AZ got set up as a healing machine to tank, Unity got some bots out to eliminate the smaller targets, and Fixer wailed away on Gloomy with occassional boosts from bloody knuckles or inspired repair.  After that, the game was never in doubt.

The most important thing I remembered was to not let Fixer open any presents as the odds were high that it would force him to lose his crowbar/monkeyfist set up.
